plugins.description: PPAP 提交资料核对：依据《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ppap-check — PPAP submission element completeness check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-ppap-check` reads one PPAP submission element checklist — the part header plus one row per element — and checks what a checklist can be held to mechanically: that an element the customer required carries a submission record, that a submitted element carries a date, that a controlled element (design record, FMEA, control plan, process flow, dimensional results, MSA) carries a revision, that the sheet names its part number and submission level, that element numbers are unique, and that no template placeholder survives in the element column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-ppap-check: real output over its PP-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-ppap-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-ppap-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PP-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| An element is marked as required in the 是否要求 column, but there is no submission record for it — is that reported? | Yes. `PP-001` reports the row when the `required` column holds a value that counts as required (`是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `要求`, `√`) while the `submitted` column is empty. It reads that column of your own checklist, never a built-in element list — which elements are required depends on the level the customer specifies — and it does not judge whether the content of what was submitted is acceptable. |
| The row is marked as submitted, but the date cell is empty. And if the date is filled in but falls after the customer's deadline? | `PP-002` reports a row whose `submitted` column holds a value that counts as submitted (`是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `已提交`, `√`) while the `submittedAt` cell is blank. It only checks that the date cell is filled in — whether the date falls inside the deadline set by the customer's project plan is not checked. |
| The control plan row is filled in but its version cell is empty — will that be reported, and what about elements that carry no revision by nature? | `PP-003` looks at element names matching `conditionPattern` — design record, engineering change, DFMEA/PFMEA, control plan, process flow, dimensional results, measurement-system analysis, samples, checking aids, PSW, material reports, preliminary process capability — and reports each matching row whose `version` cell is empty. It only checks that the version is filled in, not that it is the correct or the current revision; narrow the pattern if an element genuinely carries no revision. |
| Every element row looks complete, but the tool says the sheet is missing the part number and the level. Our form records the level on each row instead. | `PP-004` reads the header only: `partNo` and `level` must both be present at the top of the material. If your form keeps the level on the detail rows, change this rule's `fields` or write a check of your own — the rule does not look for those values inside the rows. |
| The level cell reads `Level 3`, but `PP-005` never says anything about it. | `PP-005` ships with an empty `values` list, and empty means unconfigured, so it reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing quietly. Put your customer's level spellings into `values` and it will report any value that is not on the list. Even then it only checks that the value is on your list — whether the level chosen is the right one is the customer's decision — which is why the rule is capped at `info`. |
| Our checklist was copied from last year's template: one element name still reads 【待填】 and two rows carry the same element number. | `PP-006` reports an element name that still contains a placeholder — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo`, a `terms` list you can adjust to your own template. `PP-007` reports a repeated element number in `elementNo`, comparing with whitespace ignored; a hit usually means the element was registered twice or the number was copied wrong, and which of the two it is has to be confirmed by a person. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》 | AIAG PPAP（现行版次与条号本次未核实） | PP-001, PP-002, PP-003, PP-004, PP-005, PP-006, PP-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **PPAP 提交要素清单** for what a checklist can be held to mechanically —
that an element the customer required carries a submission record, that a submitted element carries a date,
that a controlled element (design record, FMEA, control plan, process flow, dimensional results, MSA) carries
a revision, that the sheet names its part number and submission level, that element numbers are unique, and
that no template placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether PPAP may be approved, whether the level
is right, or whether an element's content satisfies the customer. **The submission level is the customer's to
set, and this plugin ships no level-to-element mapping.**

> ### ⚠️ Read this before trusting a citation in the report
>
> **Every `excerpt` in this plugin's rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not
> obtained.** The method lives in the automotive **AIAG《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》** (and the customer
> specific requirements under IATF 16949). The verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so
> rather than paraphrase a quotation the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and puts the
> honest reasoning in `note`. Every rule is therefore `warn` or `info`, and a test asserts that no rule
> claims a quotation it does not have. **When the text is in hand, two things must be done: replace each
> `excerpt` with the real clause, and raise `kind` to `direct`.**
>
> **Which elements must be submitted depends on the level the customer specifies** (Level 1–5), so `PP-001`
> reads the **checklist's own 是否要求 column** rather than any built-in list, and `PP-005`'s level vocabulary
> ships **empty** — with no vocabulary configured it reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing quietly.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for several parts use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `ppap_check` tool. It reads one submission-element checklist — the part header plus one row per
element — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PP-001` | a required element has a submission record | warn | principle |
| `PP-002` | a submitted element carries a date | warn | principle |
| `PP-003` | a controlled element carries a revision | warn | principle |
| `PP-004` | the sheet names its part number and level | warn | principle |
| `PP-005` | the level comes from your customer's vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `PP-006` | the element column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
| `PP-007` | element numbers are unique | warn | principle |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-ppap-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-ppap-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/ppap-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

Rule-level parameters worth knowing:

- `PP-001` `

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness插件：商汤日日新（SenseNova）多 Key 轮换池 — 填入key 即可零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness，遇 429 限流自动切换下一把 key。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sensenova-pool **商汤日日新（SenseNova）多 Key 轮换池 · DeepSeek Harness 插件** 在一个地方填入多把商汤 API Key，即可在 DSH 对话窗口里直接使用日日新的各种模型 —— 遇 429 限流自动切换到下一把 Key，全程无感。 [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-sensenova-pool?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sensenova-pool) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f46e5)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 中文 | [English](#english)
--- ## 功能 ### 🔑 多 Key 轮换池 填入任意多把商汤 Key，请求在多把 Key 之间自动轮转，把每把 Key 的额度摊开使用。 ![Key 管理卡片](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool/main/docs/shots/01-keys.png) - **一次粘贴多把**：换行、逗号、分号、空格分隔都可以 - **自动清洗**：识别并去除 `Bearer ` 前缀、首尾引号、重复项、明显无效的短串 - **只看得到脱敏值**：界面只显示 `sk-example...0001` 这样的掩码，明文 Key 不会出现在任何界面上 - **单把可测**：每把 Key 都能单独「测试」探活，看到真实的可用状态与延迟 - **单独删除**：任意一把失效随时移除，不影响其他 Key ### 🛡 429 限流自动切换 这是本插件的核心能力。商汤的 Key 有较低的 RPM 上限（实测现有 Key 约 3 RPM），单靠重试无法解决。本插件的做法： - 遇 429 **立即切换到下一把 Key** 重试，用户看不到任何报错 - 每把 Key 独立冷却，按指数退避 + 随机抖动错开解冻时间 - 本地 RPM 预限流主动排队，**从源头避开**限流，而不是挨打后再退避 - 池子真的耗尽时，回报 `503 + Retry-After`（而不是 429），交由 DSH 自行退避重试 - 429 计数与冷却状态在卡片上实时可见 截图中的 `3/9 成功，6 次限流` 就是真实发生的记录：这把 Key 触发了 6 次 429，全部被池子内部消化，上层没有收到过一个 429。 ### 🧠 一次接入全部模型 装好插件后，模型选择器里自动出现「商汤日日新（Key 轮换池）」分组，包含以下模型： | 模型 | 上下文 | 最大输出 | 图片输入 | |---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 1,048,576 | 65,536 | – | | `deepseek-v4-flash` | 1,048,576 | 65,536 | – | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 1,048,576 | 65,536 | – | | `deepseek-flash` | 1,048,576 | 65,536 | – | | `glm-5.2` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | – | | `kimi-k3` | 1,048,576 | 65,536 | – | | `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` | 262,144 | 65,536 | ✓ | 启动时内置一份保守目录（无需网络即可用），拿到有效 Key 后自动通过 `/v1/models` 刷新，**商汤日后上线新模型无需升级插件**。 思考等级同样支持，可选 `none / low / medium / high / xhigh`。 ### ⚙️ 零配置 Key 存在 DSH 的凭据库里，不写进任何配置文件。填入即生效，无需重启 DSH、无需改 YAML。 --- ## 安装 ### 方式一：npm（推荐） ```bash npm install dsh-sensenova-pool ``` 或使用 pnpm： ```bash pnpm add dsh-sensenova-pool ``` 安装后，把 `dsh-sensenova-pool` 加入 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`： ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "dsh-sensenova-pool" ] } } } ``` ### 方式二：本地开发 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool.git cd dsh-sensenova-pool npm install npm run build # 链接到你的 profile pnpm --dir "$DSH_PROFILE_DIR" add "link:$PWD" ``` 同样需要把 `dsh-sensenova-pool` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。 ### 重启 DSH 改完 `package.json` 后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**。确认安装成功：插件页的「已安装」列表里会出现本插件。 ![插件页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool/main/docs/shots/02-installed.png) --- ## 使用 ### 1. 填入 Key 打开 **插件 → dsh-sensenova-pool**，在弹出的卡片里粘贴一把或多把商汤 Key： ``` sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sk-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb sk-cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc ``` 点「**添加 Key**」。支持多种分隔方式，重复和无效项会被自动过滤。 ### 2. 选择模型 新建会话，在模型选择器里选「**商汤日日新（Key 轮换池）**」下的任意模型，然后正常对话即可。 ### 3. 需要时调整 | 按钮 | 作用 | |---|---| | **测试** | 对单把 Key 发一次极小请求，立刻看到是否可用与延迟 | | **删除** | 移除单把 Key | | **清空全部** | 移除所有 Key | | **刷新模型列表** | 主动从商汤 `/v1/models` 拉取最新模型目录 | --- ## 配置项（可选） 绝大多数情况无需改动。如需微调，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加入： ```yaml - id: llm-sensenova-pool name: dsh-sensenova-pool config: rpmLimit: 2 # 每把 Key 的本地 RPM 预限流上限；0 = 关闭 maxAttempts: 6 # 单个请求最多尝试几把 Key maxConcurrency: 1 # 每把 Key 的并发上限；1 = 串行（推荐） acquireTimeoutMs: 180000 requestTimeoutMs: 60000 baseUrl: https://token.sensenova.cn/v1 ``` `rpmLimit: 2` 是默认值，基于实测（真实上限约 3 RPM）。**调大它不会提高吞吐，只会更容易被限流** —— 想提高吞吐应该增加 Key，而不是加压。 --- ## 常见问题 **模型选择器里没有「商汤日日新」分组？** 确认 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有 `dsh-sensenova-pool`，然后**重启 DSH**。 **插件卡片打不开？** 在插件页「已安装」列表里点本插件进入详情页。 **一直失败怎么办？** 在卡片上点某把 Key 的「测试」看真实原因。`403 model is not available in the current token plan` 表示该模型不在这个 Key 的套餐里 —— 换模型，而不是换 Key。 **DSH 弹「The application could not start or stopped unexpectedly」，完全起不来？** 先看崩溃日志里的失败插件名。如果 `Failed plugins` 指向 `credentials`，且错误是 `record "dsh-sensenova-pool/keys" ... has unknown field "payload"`，说明凭据库里那条记录 的标签写错了 —— DSH 的凭据库对记录做白名单校验，`api-key` 只认 `kind`/`key`/`env`， `grant` 只认 `kind`/`payload`，**一条记录不合规就会让 `credentials` 插件激活失败，进而 中止整个应用启动**（0.1.1 及更早版本存在这个写入 bug，已修复）。 手工修复：编辑 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，把该记录的 `kind: api-key` 改成 `kind: grant`（`payload.keys` 里的 Key 原样保留），然后重启 DSH。 ```yaml records: dsh-sensenova-pool/keys: kind: grant # ← 必须是 grant；api-key 不接受 payload payload: keys: - sk-… ``` 崩溃日志位置：Windows 下为 `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-host.log`。 **Key 会泄漏吗？** 不会。界面只显示掩码；明文只存在 DSH 凭据库（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`）中，不会写入任何配置文件，也不会出现在日志里。 --- ## 环境要求 - DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` 或更高 - Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` --- ## 致谢 本插件在设计与实现上参考了以下开源项目，特此致谢： - **[corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect)** —— 将第三方模型接入 DSH 的插件范式。本插件的 provider 注册方式与浏览器卡片结构参考了该项目。 - **[Phoeky/st-rotator](https://github.com/Phoeky/st-rotator)** —— 商汤 Key 轮换网关。本插件的轮换调度、冷却退避与本地预限流策略参考了该项目。 --- ## 许可 [MIT](./LICENSE) --- ## English **A multi-key rotation pool for SenseNova (商汤日日新) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.** Paste one or more SenseNova API keys in one place and use every SenseNova model directly in the DSH chat window — rate-limited keys (HTTP 429) are switched out automatically and transparently. ### Features - **Multi-key pool** — paste any number of keys at once (newline / comma / semicolon separated); prefixes, quotes, duplicates and junk are cleaned automatically - **Automatic 429 failover** — on rate limiting the pool immediately retries with the next key; each key cools down independently with exponential backoff and jitter, plus local RPM pre-throttling to avoid 429s in the first place - **Never leaks a 429 upward** — when every key is exhausted the plugin reports `503 + Retry-After` so DSH backs off on its own - **All models, zero config** — a built-in catalogue works offline and refreshes from `/v1/models` once a valid key is present, so new models need no plugin upgrade - **Keys are masked** — only `sk-example...0001` style masks are ever displayed ### Install ```bash npm install dsh-sensenova-pool ``` Add `"dsh-sensenova-pool"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in your profile `package.json`, then restart DeepSeek Harness. ### Usage Open **Plugins → dsh-sensenova-pool**, paste your keys, click **Add keys**, then pick any model under the "商汤日日新（Key 轮换池）" group in the model picker. ### Acknowledgements - [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) — the plugin pattern for bringing third-party models into DSH - [Phoeky/st-rotator](https://github.com/Phoeky/st-rotator) — the SenseNova key-rotation gateway this plugin's rotation strategy derives from ### License [MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Connects DSH to the Unity MCP server
plugins.readme_text:
# @comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp

Connects DSH to the **Unity MCP** server — the `unity-ai-relay` executable the
Unity AI Assistant package (`com.unity.ai.assistant`) installs — through the
stock `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` stdio bridge, plus a settings/status card in
the Web GUI.

Every tool the relay registers is exposed as a normal `mcp__unity__*` tool.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp
```

The plugin **does not download anything**: it launches the `unity-ai-relay`
executable your Unity Editor installed. Install the
[Unity AI Assistant](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.ai.assistant@2.0/manual/unity-mcp-get-started.html)
package first, and keep a Unity Editor running — the relay is the Editor's
side-channel, so an Editor that is not running answers
`No Unity Editor connected`.

## Configuration

Settings live under **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → DSH Unity MCP**.

- **Unity relay executable** — the executable the bridge launches. Open the
  picker, hit **Fetch executables** to search this machine (the search also walks
  every Windows user profile visible from a WSL host), and pick one. The pick is
  remembered; applying a different one restarts the connection.
- **Extra flags** — one flag per row, appended after the `--mcp` mode flag the
  bridge always passes, for example `--project-path=/home/roberto/game`,
  `--name=MyProject`, `--log-level=debug`.
- **Reduce log output** — keeps the relay's own progress lines out of the DSH
  console by redirecting its stderr into a log file (turn it off to debug the
  raw output).

Nothing is picked for you: what the saved rows list is what you can pick, and a
path you picked stays picked — if it later stops running it reads broken, it is
never silently re-resolved.

### Windows relay from WSL

A Windows relay launched through the WSL interop mount works like a native one:
it speaks MCP over stdio, so nothing about the connection changes. The card says
so when that is what is running, and reminds you to keep the relay's arguments
(`--log-dir`, and `--project-path` when you pin a project) in their Windows
spelling — the relay resolves them on the Windows side.

## Row configuration

For a per-profile pin, edit the plugin row's `config`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serverName` | `unity` | the bridge's server namespace (tool names are `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`) |
| `relayPath` | `""` | the executable to launch when the card has never picked one |
| `relayPaths` | the platform's relay locations | the candidate list the **Search executables** run probes |
| `extraFlags` | `[]` | flags appended after the `--mcp` mode flag |
| `command` | `""` | a launcher prefix to wrap the spawn with (the relay needs no wrapper) |
| `env` / `cwd` | `{}` / `""` | passed through to the bridge |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | per-tool-call timeout |
| `failOnStartupError` | `false` | fail the load when the bridge cannot start |
| `reconnect` | `{ enabled: true, initialDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 30000, maxAttempts: 10 }` | reconnect policy |
| `bridgeStderr` | `"log"` | console-output routing: `"log"` captures stderr into a log file, `"console"` echoes it |
| `bridgeStderrLog` | `""` | log path override for `"log"` mode (absolute paths only) |

The environment variable `DSH_UNITY_MCP_FLAGS` (whitespace-separated) seeds the
launch flags for one run.

## Manual installation

Replace `/path/to/dsh-unity-mcp` with your local checkout:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@comecaramelos
ln -s /path/to/dsh-unity-mcp ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp
```

Add the dependency and bundle to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`, preserving
existing entries:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp": "link:/path/to/dsh-unity-mcp"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

---

# dsh-shader-workbench [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-98%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](docs/开发与验证.md) [![dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)](docs/开发与验证.md) **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) **DSH Shader 工作台**：节点式搭 GLSL → Shadertoy 兼容实时预览 → 热重载 → 本地材质资源管理。 装在 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 里是一个侧栏入口 + 一整块工作台面板， 同时给 agent 开放 9 个工具，让它能直接建项目、搭节点图、编译、导出、打快照。 - **零第三方运行时依赖**：没有构建链，全是手写 ESM JavaScript，装上去就是一个目录。 - **节点图 = 程序**：内置节点库只放 **55 个通用件**；效果专用逻辑一律拆成图上能展开编辑的普通节点，不做黑盒。 - **重复是语言结构**：组的「重复次数」> 1 就是循环，循环体只写一遍（IFS 隧道 99 步、贝塞尔 24 段都靠它，图和着色器小两个数量级）。 - **可扩展、免重启**：用户节点丢个 JSON 进 `<工作区>/library/nodes/` 就能加；节点分类和项目名都支持多级。 - **面板和 agent 共用一套工具与工作区**：存储位置能在面板里改，两边看到的永远是同一份数据。 - **104 个用例**：含真机 WebGL2 编译校验、GPU 像素回读、真鼠标拖拽交互、1080p 性能度量。 ## 装上 ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop # package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-shader-workbench": "file:<本仓库路径>" # dsh.profile.bundles 加 "dsh-shader-workbench" node install ``` 然后重启 DSH，侧栏会出现「Shader 工作台」。存储位置、配置项、加载排查见 [安装与配置](docs/安装与配置.md)。 ## 七个自带示例 面板资源树里点 **载入示例** 即可。**一个新节点都没加**，全部用现有组件搭出来。

IFS 隧道（Phantom Star 移植）
99 步累积 = 一个重复组，和原版逐像素一致
DFT 本轮画心形
每个旋转向量一个节点，轨迹靠 BufferA 反馈

9 抽样高斯模糊
双 Pass，半径可拖
三次贝塞尔
24 段采样是一个重复组，四个控制点可拖
另外三个（傅里叶级数 / 谐波频谱 / 景深）和每个示例的做法见 [示例说明](examples/README.md)。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [安装与配置](docs/安装与配置.md) | 装上、存储位置与优先级、安全边界、加载排查 | | [使用手册](docs/使用手册.md) | 界面、画布操作与快捷键、节点库 55 个节点、9 个工具、工作区结构 | | [扩展指南](docs/扩展指南.md) | 加节点的三条路：用户节点 / 组与重复组 / 内置节点 | | [开发与验证](docs/开发与验证.md) | 开发命令、真机验证与实测性能、体积、本版没做的 | | [接口契约](docs/接口契约.md) | HTTP 动作、节点定义与代码生成契约（**改代码前先看这份**） | | [架构说明](docs/架构说明.md) | 分层、数据流、关键设计取舍与踩过的坑 | | [验收报告](docs/验收报告.md) | 各里程碑的真机验收记录 | | [示例说明](examples/README.md) | 7 个示例分别演示了什么、怎么搭的 | > 详细文档目前以中文为主；英文的 issue / PR 一样欢迎。 ## 仓库 - 仓库： - 问题反馈： - 许可：[MIT](LICENSE) --- 名字里的 "workbench" 是字面意思：它是个工作台，不是渲染引擎 —— 引擎只有 WebGL2，剩下的是「让你能一边连节点一边看画面」的那些东西。

plugins.description: Cross-project pinned Session groups for DeepSeek Harness Web (alpha preview)
plugins.readme_text: # DSH Session Groups DSH Session Groups 是一个独立安装的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。在不修改 DSH 源码的前提下，它在原生 Workspace 项目树上方增加一个跨项目“置顶”区域，并允许用户把置顶 Session 整理到自定义分组中。 ## 预览状态 当前公开的是 alpha 预览源码，四个 `@umialpha` 包尚未发布到 npm。下方 npm 安装命令仅供发布后使用，现在执行会找不到插件包。自动化测试和本地打包安装已通过；真实鼠标拖入置顶、组间移动及拖放排序仍待验收，不作为已通过的浏览器能力宣传。 ![置顶与工作区同级显示的浅色预览](docs/screenshots/D-002-sidebar-light.jpg) ## 功能 - 保留官方 Workspace 的真实目录发现、项目树、搜索、原生置顶、Session 操作和导航行为。 - “置顶”和“工作区”作为同级区块显示；置顶整体可折叠，在搜索和列表模式中仍可见，不使用 tab，也不显示“未分组”标签。 - 空安装通过现有入口选择真实文件夹，不自动创建默认工作区目录；已有工作区和 Session 正常保留。 - 创建、重命名、删除、折叠和排序命名分组。 - 在默认层、组内和组间拖动 Session。 - 从任意项目直接拖入未置顶 Session；插件先调用原生置顶，再保存目标位置。 - 删除分组时只移除布局分组，成员仍保持置顶。 - 刷新或重启 DSH 后保留分组与顺序。 分组只是原生置顶集合的布局。它不会改变 Session 的项目归属、cwd 或项目内原生顺序，Session 仍显示在原项目中。 ## 兼容性 | 插件版本 | DeepSeek Harness | Cordis | |---|---|---| | `0.1.0` | `0.2.1-alpha.2` | `4.0.5-alpha.1` | 当前版本只支持表中的精确 DSH 版本。bundle 的 peer dependency 会在读取替换配置前拒绝不兼容版本，避免出现官方 Workspace 已停用但替代入口无法加载的半激活状态。 DSH 的 npm `latest` 当前为 `0.2.0-rc.2`，不在支持范围内；请显式使用上表 alpha 版本，不要只安装未指定版本的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`。 ## 安装（插件发布到 npm 后） 发布到 npm 后，只安装 bundle；另外三个运行包会作为依赖自动安装： ```sh npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2 dsh plugin --profile web add @umialpha/dsh-session-groups@0.1.0 dsh web ``` 不需要修改 DSH 源码、profile YAML 或 Workspace 配置。请打开本次 `dsh web` 输出的完整 URL；旧端口或缺少认证参数的 URL 可能显示 `dsh web authentication required`。 如果使用本仓库的未发布版本，请先执行 `pnpm run build` 和安装 smoke；不要只链接 bundle 而遗漏另外三个 workspace 包。 本地安装 smoke 使用临时 `DSH_HOME` 和四包 tarball，只用于开发验证，不会把插件安装到你的日常 Web profile。 ## 使用 1. 继续使用原生“置顶”操作，或把项目树中的 Session 拖到顶部置顶区域。 2. 点击置顶标题右侧的新增按钮创建分组。 3. 拖动普通 Session、命名分组或组内 Session 调整布局。 4. 分组中的 Session 菜单可重命名、分叉、归档、移出分组或取消置顶。 blank Session 仍可打开，但没有时间、操作菜单或拖动能力。它在产生第一条内容并成为普通 Session 后恢复这些行为。 置顶整体折叠状态在当前页面内保留，刷新默认展开；分组与 Session 的顺序仍持久保存。已有自动目录在插件侧显示存储标题 default-workspace；官方 composer 对该历史标题仍会显示本地化默认名称，可通过工作区菜单自行重命名，插件不会改动用户目录或标题。 ## 数据与恢复 `WorkspaceRegistry.pinnedSessionIds` 始终是置顶成员资格的唯一权威。插件只在 `pinned_session_groups` storage domain 保存分组标题、组顺序和置顶 Session 的布局顺序。 移除插件会恢复官方 Workspace；原生置顶集合和 Session 数据不会被删除，分组 sidecar 数据会保留以供以后重新安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @umialpha/dsh-session-groups dsh web ``` 如果插件入口激活失败，也使用上面的移除命令并重启 Web profile。Client HMR 不是跨入口事务，失败时不会自动恢复官方 Workspace。 ## 开发与验证 要求 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` 和 pnpm `11.28.5`。 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run lint pnpm run build pnpm exec vitest run packages/client/ui-session-groups/tests node tests/install/session-groups.smoke.mjs --dsh-cli /absolute/path/to/dsh ``` 当前完整实现任务与验证记录见 [T-002](tickets/T-002-complete-session-groups.html)。历史设计与评审材料可从 Git 历史查阅。 ## 作者与反馈 作者：[`umialpha`](https://github.com/umialpha) · [roy236977634@gmail.com](mailto:roy236977634@gmail.com)。问题和建议请提交到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/umialpha/dsh-session-groups/issues)。 社区源码预览已发布到官方 [Show Your Plugins!](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9426)，原文见 [community-post.md](docs/community-post.md)。[1024 社区目录投稿 PR](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins/pull/591)已通过静态审核并合并；npm 尚未发布，按目录规则以仅浏览方式收录，不提供安装命令。 ## 许可证 本项目的原创部分按 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。`@umialpha/dsh-client-ui-workspace-groups` 基于 DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2` 的 Workspace 实现；上游代码继续保留 DeepSeek 的 MIT 许可与版权。完整归属见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Live status badge + non-interrupting in-flight guidance for DeepSeek Harness · DSH 会话头实时状态徽标 + 运行中指导（不打断，支持图片附件与插话历史）
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-steer 中文 | [English](#english) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在会话头放一个实时状态徽标，并允许你在 Agent 干活的中途补一句、纠一句，而不用打断它。 Agent 跑长任务时有两个具体的麻烦。第一，你不知道它此刻在做什么——「等待响应」和「真的卡住」看起来一模一样。第二，你发现方向不对时，只能等它做完，或者直接打断，没有中间选项。这个插件分别解决这两件事。 ## 快速开始 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` 装完重启应用（`bundles` 只在启动时读一次）。之后会话头右上角会出现状态徽标和「指导」按钮。 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness.app）独占管理自己的 profile，需要用应用自带的 CLI： ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` ## 状态徽标 徽标只显示当前阶段，按发生的顺序推进：分析中 → 思考中 · 本步 N 字 → 输出中 · 本步 N 字 → 运行 <工具> → 读取工具结果，收尾回到「工作中」。工具阶段后面跟一句命令摘要，例如「运行 bash · Run route probes」。 有两处刻意的取舍。字数是按步统计的——每个 turn/step 边界重新计数，而不是整段会话的累计值，后者最终只会变成一个越来越大的无意义数字。徽标也不显示模型名，模型、provider、上下文窗口和步号（`T4·S3`）都放在点开的详情面板里，徽标本身保持安静。 耗时秒数由客户端本地时钟计算，host 只发时间戳，所以空闲时没有定时器，也不会每秒推一次 SSE。 状态不猜。没有新进展时显示「暂无新增量」，实时源断开时显示「状态实时源断开」，而不是继续挂着上一次的阶段。请求失败只显示官方返回的 `failure.code`；只有 `llm/retry` 真的触发才显示重试，不写「可能是网络问题」这种无法证明的话。 ## 运行中指导 这是插件的主要能力。你写一句话，它会在当前回合内、最近一次小步（一次推理或一次工具调用）结束的边界被读进上下文，任务继续往下跑——不打断、不重开、不等整轮结束。 实现上用自定义消息 kind（`source.kind` 为 `dsh-steer`）加 `agent.steer()`。这一点是关键：如果按普通用户消息投递，模型会把它当成一条新任务，表现就是打断当前工作。 指导框支持直接贴图或选文件，附件经宿主的 `attachments` 服务落成持久引用。输入框按会话保存草稿，刷新不丢。 浮层里会列出本次会话发出的插话，每条标出它的归宿： - ✓ 已读取，并标出在第几轮第几步被读到，例如 `T7·S3` - · 已送达，还没被读 - ✗ 未读取，回合已结束或消息被丢弃 点任意一条可以把原文回填到输入框；未读取的可以一键重发，重发会带上原来的附件，不需要重新上传。历史只收本插件发出的插话，主对话框里的聊天记录不算。 界面语言在详情面板里切换，可选自动、中文、English。选择写在 `~/.dsh/dsh-steer.lang`，不使用 localStorage。 ## 为什么不提供排队和官方插话 官方的 queue 和 steer 本质上都是「以用户身份发一条消息」——对话框本来就能发，官方队列栏本来就能排队。所以 v0.1.0 把这两条通道删掉了，插件只保留上面那条不打断的投递。 ## 数据通道 | 路由 | 用途 | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-steer/state?session=` | SSE 实时快照，仅状态变化时推送 | | `POST /dsh-steer/steer` | 运行中指导。请求体为 `{sessionId, text?, attachments?, reuseAtts?}`，其中 `reuseAtts` 用于重发时复用已有附件，不重传字节 | | `GET /dsh-steer/attachment?session=&id=[&raw=1]` | 读取指导附件，`raw=1` 时直接回字节流 | | `GET\|POST /dsh-steer/lang` | 界面语言，取值 `auto`、`zh`、`en` | | `GET /dsh-steer/ping` | 健康检查 | 出错时返回稳定的错误码：`mode-removed`（400）、`no-live-agent`（409）、`missing sessionId or content`（400）、`payload too large`（413）、`no-attachments` 与 `no-attachment-api`（501）、`reuse-attachment-unreadable`（404）。客户端按语言把这些码映射成提示文案，界面不会直接显示中文原文。 ## 安全 插件不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai` 包，只使用 `ctx.agents` 与 `ctx.webServer` 两个公开服务，另外可选地取用 `attachments` 和 `sessionController`。所有路由只接受 loopback 地址（127.0.0.1 与 ::1），没有遥测，也没有对外网络请求。 请求体分两档限制：纯文字 3 KB，带附件 48 MB——上限先按宿主 `imageLimits` 计算，再封顶，避免宿主报出的 200 MB 上限把内存撑爆。附件字节只通过官方 `sessionController.attachment` 读回，该方法会校验该附件确实属于目标会话日志。 ## 测试 ```bash npm test ``` 38 个用例，覆盖状态机（含步切换归零）、附件链路（含宿主不支持时的 501 分支）、路由错误码、语言处理，以及客户端的纯显示逻辑。零依赖，跑在 `node --test` 上。 ## 刻意不做的事 这个插件的核心只有一件事：工作中途加一条指令。因此排队与改撤排队消息、投递模式、子代理进度、token 面板、可配置阈值、localStorage 都不做。 ## 许可证 MIT © 2026 Lyon --- # English [中文](#dsh-steer) | English A DeepSeek Harness plugin: a live status badge in the session header, plus a way to add or correct an instruction while the agent is working, without interrupting it. Long agent runs cause two specific problems. First, you cannot tell what the agent is doing right now — "waiting for a response" and "genuinely stuck" look identical. Second, when you notice the direction is wrong, your only options are to wait for the whole turn or to interrupt it. There is nothing in between. This plugin addresses both. ## Quick start ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` Restart the app afterwards (`bundles` are read once at startup). The status badge and a "Guide" button then appear in the session header. The desktop app (DeepSeek Harness.app) manages its profile exclusively, so use the CLI carrier that ships with it: ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` ## The status badge The badge shows one phase at a time and advances in order: Analyzing → Thinking · N chars this step → Writing · N chars → Running → Reading tool result, then back to Working. During a tool call it appends a short summary, for example "Running bash · Run route probes". Two deliberate trade-offs. Character counts are per step — they reset at every turn/step boundary instead of accumulating over the whole stream, which only ever produced a meaningless growing number. The badge also omits the model name; model, provider, context window and step (`T4·S3`) live in the popover, so the badge itself stays quiet. Elapsed time is computed by a local clock in the client — the host only sends timestamps — so there is no timer while idle and no SSE push every second. The badge does not guess. With no new progress it shows "no new progress"; if the live source drops it shows "live source disconnected" rather than keeping a stale phase on screen. A failed request shows the official `failure.code`; a retry appears only when `llm/retry` actually fires, never as a guess about the network. ## In-flight guidance This is the plugin's main capability. You write a sentence, and it is read into context inside the current turn, at the end of the nearest small step (one reasoning block or one tool call). The task keeps running: no interrupt, no restart, no waiting for the turn to finish. It works through a custom message kind (`source.kind` is `dsh-steer`) plus `agent.steer()`. That detail matters. Delivered as an ordinary user message, the model would treat it as a new task — which is exactly what an interruption looks like. The guidance box accepts pasted images and selected files; attachments are committed as durable references through the host's `attachments` service. Drafts are stored per session, so a refresh does not lose them. The popover lists the guidance sent in this session, each entry marked with where it ended up: - ✓ read, with the turn and step where it was consumed, for example `T7·S3` - · delivered, not read yet - ✗ not read — the turn ended, or the message was discarded Click any entry to put its text back in the input. Entries that were never read can be resent in one click, and the resend carries the original attachments instead of uploading them again. The list only contains guidance sent from this plugin; messages from the main composer are not included. The UI language switches in the detail popover: Auto, 中文 or English. The choice is stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-steer.lang`; localStorage is not used. ## Why there is no queue and no official steer The official queue and steer are both just "send a message as the user" — the composer already does that, and the official queue bar already queues. v0.1.0 removed both channels, leaving only the non-interrupting delivery described above. ## Data channels | Route | Purpose | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-steer/state?session=` | SSE live snapshot, pushed on change only | | `POST /dsh-steer/steer` | In-flight guidance. Body: `{sessionId, text?, attachments?, reuseAtts?}`; `reuseAtts` reuses existing attachments when resending, without re-uploading | | `GET /dsh-steer/attachment?session=&id=[&raw=1]` | Read a guidance attachment; `raw=1` streams the bytes | | `GET\|POST /dsh-steer/lang` | UI language: `auto`, `zh` or `en` | | `GET /dsh-steer/ping` | Health check | Failures return stable codes: `mode-removed` (400), `no-live-agent` (409), `missing sessionId or content` (400), `payload too large` (413), `no-attachments` and `no-attachment-api` (501), `reuse-attachment-unreadable` (404). The client maps each code to a localized message, so the UI never shows the raw Chinese text. ## Security The plugin imports no `@deepseek-ai` package. It uses the public services `ctx.agents` and `ctx.webServer`, and optionally `attachments` and `sessionController`. Every route accepts loopback addresses only (127.0.0.1 and ::1). There is no telemetry and no outbound network request. Request bodies are capped in two tiers: 3 KB for text only, 48 MB with attachments — the limit is computed from the host's `imageLimits` and then clamped, so the 200 MB figure the host reports can

plugins.readme_text:
# outbox

> 把本地目录可靠地送上 GitHub。一句话，不翻车。

[English abstract](#english-abstract) · MIT

`outbox` 把「推送」从一个每次都要现场拼命令的临时动作，变成一条**确定性的流水线**：

```
代理自动探测 → gh 登录态自愈 → 推送前安全闸门 → 建仓 / 提交 / 推送 → 远端 SHA 回读校验
```

**一份内核，三种用法**：命令行、任何 Agent（读 `SKILL.md`）、DeepSeek Harness 插件（`dsh-github-push`）。
三种外壳共用同一份代码，不存在「插件和 CLI 行为不一致」的问题。

---

## 它到底解决了什么

推送失败几乎从来不是因为 `git push` 写错了，而是因为**周围那些没人管的事**。下面是真实踩过的坑，以及 outbox 的处理方式：

| 真实故障 | 为什么会发生 | outbox 怎么处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `gh` 突然报「未登录」，可 `git push` 明明好好的 | gh 把登录态存在自己的 `hosts.yml` 里，该文件会因版本升级/配置迁移被清空；但 token 一直躺在系统凭据管理器里 | 检测到未登录时，从凭据管理器取出 token 自动灌回 gh，并**重新校验** |
| 网络时通时不通、推送卡死 | 环境变量里的代理并不是每条调用链都带着；代理关掉后变量还指着死端口 | 每次先探测端口，通则**按次注入**代理、不通则只清掉指向该端口的陈旧变量后直连 |
| 推着推着要输密码，挂在半路 | git 交互式询问 | 子进程一律置 `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`，宁可清清楚楚失败，也不静默挂起 |
| 密钥被推上公开仓库 | 没人会在推送前逐行看 diff | 推送前扫描**即将提交的索引**，命中高危内容直接阻断 |
| 命令返回 0，但推的是旧东西 | 退出码不等于结果 | 推送后回读远端分支，**要求远端 SHA 严格等于本地 HEAD** 才算成功 |
| 仓库里写死了本机用户目录的绝对路径 | 无意识泄露身份 | 扫描绝对路径中的用户名、身份证号、手机号等，命中后**禁止自动公开** |

---

## 安装

零依赖，只要 Node ≥ 18。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-account>/outbox.git
cd outbox
node src/cli.mjs --help
```

## 用法

```bash
# 先看一眼会发生什么（只做预检，不提交不推送）
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility private --dry-run

# 发布到私有仓库（仓库不存在会自动创建）
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility private --description "我的项目"

# 明确要开源时才用 public
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility public
```

常用选项：

| 选项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `--dir <路径>` | 要发布的目录（默认当前目录） |
| `--name <仓库名>` | 远端仓库名（默认由目录名规整而来） |
| `--visibility <值>` | `public` / `private` / `ask`（默认 `ask`） |
| `--proxy <值>` | `auto` / `off` / `http://host:port`（默认 `auto`，探测 7890） |
| `--proxy-port <端口>` | 代理探测端口，默认 `7890` |
| `--dry-run` | 只做预检 |
| `--json` | 结构化输出，便于脚本与 Agent 消费 |

退出码：`0` 成功 · `1` 出错 · `2` 预检阻断 · `3` 需要你先做决定

## 安全闸门

扫描的对象是**索引**（`git ls-files --cached`），也就是真正会被推上去的东西——因此 `.gitignore` 覆盖的文件天然不会被误报。

命中结果分三级：

| 级别 | 含义 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `block` | 高置信度凭据：GitHub/OpenAI/AWS 令牌、私钥文件内容、`.env`/`*.pem`/`id_rsa` 等文件名、超过 95 MiB 的文件 | **硬阻断**，远端不会被创建 |
| `confirm` | 疑似个人敏感信息：身份证号、手机号、学号字段、暴露本机用户名的绝对路径，以及你自己的自定义模式 | **禁止自动公开**，必须逐条确认 |
| `warn` | 疑似明文口令/密钥赋值、超过 10 MiB 的大文件、**已被 gitignore 覆盖却仍在版本控制中的残留** | 只提示，不阻断 |

补充自定义模式：在 `~/.outbox/patterns.json` 写

```json
{ "confirm": [{ "id": "my-secret", "label": "我自己的敏感词", "pattern": "公司内部代号" }] }
```

### 放行清单

任何**带测试夹具的仓库**都会天然含有假密钥——测试扫描器就得放几个假 token 进去。没有出口的话，这种仓库会被自己的闸门拦住（outbox 第一次推送时，确实拦住了它自己）。

两种放行方式：

**仓库级**：在仓库根目录写 `.outboxallow`，每行一条：

```
# <路径 glob> [规则 id]
tests/selftest.mjs    github-token
tests/**/*.fixture.js
```

省略规则 id 表示放行该路径下的全部规则，但**建议永远写明确则 id**——放行范围越小越容易审计。这个文件本身会随仓库一起提交，所以「谁放行了什么」永远可查。

**行内**：在同一行写上 `outbox:allow`，该行的内容规则全部跳过。

被放行的命中不会凭空消失，而是记入结果的 `allowlisted` 字段，依旧可见。

## 设计取舍

**为什么代理不写进 git 全局配置？**
写全局最省事，但一旦代理软件关掉，本机**所有** git 操作（包括别的仓库）都会连不上。outbox 只在本次命令上用 `-c http.proxy=...` 注入，不留后遗症。

**为什么不用 `where.exe` 定位 git/gh？**
Windows 控制台工具按 OEM 代码页输出，而 Node 按 UTF-8 解码。只要可执行文件路径含中文（例如用户名是中文），解析结果就会变成一串替换字符，随后 `spawn` 报 `ENOENT`。更阴险的是 Git 常装在纯 ASCII 路径下所以一切正常——这个 bug 只在中文用户名的机器上爆发。正确做法是**把裸名字交给 Windows 自己按 PATH 解析**。

**为什么推送成功的判据是 SHA 而不是退出码？**
`git push` 返回 0 只代表命令没报错，不代表远端真的有你要的那个提交。回读 `git ls-remote` 拿到远端分支 SHA、与本地 `HEAD` 严格比对，才是可信证据。

**为什么安全闸门扫描索引而不是目录？**
索引就是「将要被推送的内容」，天然排除了忽略项，不会对 `.gitignore` 里的东西误报。

## 作为 Agent Skill 使用

`SKILL.md` 是给任意 Agent（Claude Code / Codex / DSH / 其它）读的说明书。把它放进你的技能目录，或直接贴进系统提示，Agent 就知道什么时候该调 `outbox`、什么时候必须先问用户。

## 相关项目

- **[`dsh-plugin/`](dsh-plugin/)** —— 同一份内核的 DSH 工具壳，注册模型工具 `github_push`，让「一句话推送」真正落地。源码就在本仓库里；它同时单独发布为一个 `dsh-github-push` 仓库，以便被 DSH 插件市场收录。两处的内核副本由 `scripts/sync-plugin.mjs` 机械同步，不存在第二份手写实现。
- [`dsh-plugin-publish`](https://github.com/suyukun/dsh-plugin-publish) —— 面向 Agent 技能的**发布流程协议**（preflight → 建仓 → awesome 列表 PR → 市场提交）。它是「说明书」，outbox 是「代码内核」，两者互补。

## English abstract

`outbox` reliably pushes a local folder to GitHub in a single command. It wraps the parts that actually break: auto-detecting a local proxy (default port 7890) and injecting it **per command** instead of globally, self-healing a `gh` login by recovering the token from the OS credential store, gating the push behind a secret/PII scan of the staged index, and verifying success by reading back the remote branch SHA instead of trusting an exit code. Zero dependencies, Node ≥ 18. One core, three shells: CLI, agent skill, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
